unlisted_practices: Establish standard protocols for data collection and sharing, including data formats, secure repositories, and access protocols, across industry and research institutions.
Governments should fund ML research for drug side effect prediction and provide regulatory incentives for adopting validated models.
Regulatory agencies should provide clear guidelines for ML adoption at each stage of drug development.
Governments should facilitate pilot programs and regulatory sandboxes to test ML integration in drug development.
Implement public education campaigns about ML use in drug development, communicating limitations and potential biases and tailored to patients, professionals, and developers.
Government agencies should establish fairness benchmarks and enforce regular audits of ML models.
Adopt explainable AI techniques and regulatory guidance to improve model transparency.
Draft data-sharing agreements that define data access, use, and ownership and protect patient privacy.
Mandate human oversight in critical decisions made with ML.
